**Reference image analysis - Leaf_Mold:**
The Leaf_Mold reference shows pale yellowish/greenish discoloration on the upper leaf surface with olive mold growth. This does NOT match the test image, which shows distinct dark brown/black spots (not pale yellow) and a grayish/dusty patch.

- Some spots appear to have dark perimeters/borders

The dark spots with somewhat angular/irregular shapes and dark borders closely match **Septoria_Leaf_Blotch** — which produces small spots with tan-to-gray centers and dark-brown perimeters. The grayish dusty area could represent the tan/gray centers of coalescing Septoria spots or fungal fruiting bodies (pycnidia). The spots don't show the characteristic concentric rings of Early_Blight or Target_Spot, and lack the water-soaked oily appearance of Late_Blight.
